product.name: Personal AI
product.description: An AI system that analyzes communication patterns to help users build trust and emotional safety in relationships by providing feedback on relational dynamics.

product.name: Deep Pattern Relational Agents
product.description: AI tools that analyze text conversations to reveal underlying relational patterns and emotional dynamics in personal relationships.

product.name: Agentic Meditations
product.description: A tool that transforms therapy session transcripts into interactive meditations using AI and voice cloning to support self-reflection and emotional integration.

product.name: Therapeutic Enhancement
product.description: An AI-driven service that distills therapy session content into structured, actionable insights to support ongoing personal growth and behavioral change.
